fusions.name: Pounce From Cover
fusions.desc: You spring up to 6 tiles onto the target with a blow that deals 13 damage, leaves it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds and makes it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Let It Almost Go
fusions.desc: A swat with your weapon that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Mouse-Hole Vigil
fusions.desc: After a 1-second crouch, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Plays With Its Catch
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
